description: Projets éoliens en mer flottants en Méditerranée – zone retenue pour la poursuite des études techniques et environnementales is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Cerema. Areas annexed to the Ministerial Decision of 17 March 2022 following the public debate on the project for floating wind turbines in the Mediterranean and their connection. Environmental studies will also be conducted on Area 4 from a planning perspective. Coverage: Cerema. The portal shows the English title as "Floating offshore wind projects in the Mediterranean – area selected for further technical and environmental studies" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Cerema. Its keywords include emr, donnees-ouvertes, donnees-derivees-produits-composites, sources-denergie, activites-et-usages-industrie-et-energie, metropole-mediterranee-occidentale. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
